d:
The anthem that made Parmish Verma a superstar! Gaal Ni Kadni — out on Speed Records.
Sung by Parmish Verma with lyrics by Vicky Gill and music by Desi Crew, Gaal Ni Kadni became a massive breakout hit — a full-attitude Punjabi anthem loved by fans everywhere. Directed by Parmish Verma himself. Turn it up!
Song Credit
Song - Gaal Ni Kadni
Artist - Parmish Verma
Lyrics - Vicky Gill
Music - Desi Crew
DOP - Dimple Bhullar - Amit Kumar ( Canada )
